children: RNS Number : 5958S  Tungsten West PLC  28 August 2026

Tungsten West (AIM:TUN), the mining company focused on restarting production at the Hemerdon tungsten and tin mine ("Hemerdon" or the "Project") in Devon, UK, is pleased to announce that, further to the Company's announcement of the National Wealth Fund ("NWF") fundraising on 25 August 2026, the Company has repaid in full the Short-Term Loan Facility announced on 21 May 2026. Following this repayment, the debt facility provided by the NWF has become effective.
All defined terms used in this announcement shall have the same meaning as in the Company's announcements on 21 May 2026 and 25 August 2026 unless otherwise defined herein.
James Spinney / James Dance / Abigail Wennington
Andrew Chubb / Matt Hasson / Jay Ashfield
